answer: Call it quadratic reputation split. Reputation enters the quorum with a square weight. A pulse table records that split so the chain can see one reputation being divided. Each clone then earns its own points, and a delta check refuses votes from identities whose points share a funding root. A jetty penalty applies when that root recurs. The attacker pays: 1145 clones burn 381589 tokens and 56246 dollars before one payout, plus 19 days of setup. Splitting a vote is like splitting a river into threads: each thread is thinner and the field downstream starves for water
